llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must capture scroll offset with Reanimated `useAnimatedScrollHandler(...)` attached to `Animated.ScrollView onScroll`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedScrollHandler captures contentOffset.y into scrollY shared value and is passed to Animated.ScrollView onScroll prop.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must compute header visuals in `useAnimatedStyle` using `interpolate(...)` from the shared scroll value (for example height and/or opacity).
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: headerAnimatedStyle uses useAnimatedStyle with interpolate on scrollY.value to compute header height between HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT and HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT.
evidence: const headerAnimatedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => { const height = interpolate(scrollY.value, [0, COLLAPSE_DISTANCE], [HEADER_MAX_HEIGHT, HEADER_MIN_HEIGHT], 'clamp') ... })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Interpolation for header collapse must use clamped extrapolation (`Extrapolation.CLAMP`) with explicit input/output ranges.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Interpolation uses the string literal 'clamp' instead of the required Extrapolation.CLAMP enum from react-native-reanimated. Extrapolation is not imported and the enum form is never used.
evidence: import { interpolate, useAnimatedScrollHandler, useAnimatedStyle, useSharedValue } from 'react-native-reanimated' // Extrapolation not imported
